summary: Tested new chat file-sharing + emoji picker feature end-to-end. Backend: 9/9 pytest cases pass covering /api/upload/chat/{exchange_id} happy path (png + pdf, response has path/url/name/content_type/size), /api/files/{path} returns bytes with correct content-type, guards (non-participant 403, before-accept 400, .exe unsupported 400, >10MB too-large 400), /api/messages with attachment_path only creates message with attachment fields + notification 'X sent you a file', empty-text-no-attachment 400, and plain-text regression. Frontend: /chat/{exchangeId} shows chat-attach + chat-emoji-toggle + chat-send buttons. Emoji picker opens on chat-emoji-toggle, clicking an emoji appends it to chat-input (😀 verified). Attaching a PNG shows pending-file, sending renders msg-image in chat-messages. Attaching a PDF shows pending-file, sending renders msg-file with 'notes.pdf' filename, download icon, and clickable /api/files/... link. Plain-text send still works.
passed: GET /api/files/{path} returns bytes with correct content-type
Upload to pending (not-accepted) exchange -> 400 'not accepted yet'
POST /api/messages with attachment_path only -> 200; recipient notification 'X sent you a file'
Chat UI: chat-attach, chat-emoji-toggle, chat-send, chat-file-input testids present
chat-emoji-toggle opens chat-emoji-picker; clicking emoji appends to chat-input
PNG upload -> pending-file preview -> send -> msg-image in chat-messages
PDF upload -> pending-file preview -> send -> msg-file with filename + Download icon + working /api/files link
Plain text message send + chat polling refresh still work
critical_code_review_comments: Backend allows attachment_path in POST /api/messages without validating that the path actually belongs to the sender/exchange - a user could reuse another exchange's attachment_path if they know it. Consider verifying db.files has this storage_path for this exchange_id/user. Low risk since paths are UUID-based.
GET /api/files/{path} is unauthenticated - anyone with the UUID path can fetch. Acceptable for chat attachments (obfuscated) but worth documenting.
Chat.jsx: emoji picker close-on-outside-click uses mousedown but the toggle button itself is inside the click path - works today but could regress. Minor.
seed_data_creation: Created ephemeral TEST_alice_* and TEST_bob_* users via /register plus one accepted exchange for FE test (fe_alice_*, fe_bob_*). No cleanup necessary; prefixed for identification.
test_credentials: admin@skillswap.com/admin123 (unchanged). FE test users are ephemeral per run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest at /app/backend/tests/test_chat_files.py — run with `pytest backend/tests/test_chat_files.py -v`. Uses REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. For FE testing, cookies from /api/auth/register are httpOnly + secure; backend prefers cookie over Authorization header, so when driving multiple users from one browser context use requests.Session per user (not page.request) to avoid cross-contamination.
